title: Taskbase 2024 — Hello Elementor rebuild
notes: Wayback 2024-06-15, WordPress 6.5 + Hello Elementor 3.0. Elementor loads its counter, image-carousel, loop, loop-carousel and nested-carousel handlers as runtime webpack chunks and the mirror had followed none of them, so the page showed "0x" for all four impact counters and one blown-up slide in place of every carousel. The free Elementor chunks (counter, image-carousel, text-editor) and Swiper 8.4.5 were restored from taskbase.com captures and do run. The Elementor Pro files - the loop, loop-carousel, nav-menu and nested-carousel chunks plus Pro's own frontend, webpack runtime, element handlers and the loop-builder / nested-carousel stylesheets - were deleted before publication: Pro is commercially licensed and may not be redistributed. What that costs: the three feature cards under "Overcoming the Challenges" and the three customer-story cards are laid out statically by museum.css from the widgets' own data-settings instead of scrolling, the testimonial carousel is frozen on its first slide, and the header's dropdown submenus no longer open - a click on a top-level nav item follows its link to the live site. The counters still count. Zero broken images, no horizontal overflow, nothing else reaching a live host. Forms are dead by design.
